units.source_text: 太吉郎是不是准备把这间店铺卖掉，然后在那所小房子里“养老”呢？

en.t: Was Takichiro planning to sell this shop and then retire in that little house?

units.source_text: 或者说，他也要趁手头还宽裕，早早下决心？

en.t: Or was he too going to make up his mind early, while he still had money to spare?

units.source_text: 要是这样，丈夫在南禅寺附近的小房子里打算干什么，又怎么生活下去？

en.t: If so, what did her husband intend to do in the little house near Nanzenji, and how would he go on living?

units.source_text: 丈夫已年过半百，她很想让他称心如意地过过日子。

en.t: Her husband was already past fifty, and she very much wanted him to live for a while in a way that pleased him.
The shop was certainly worth a great deal.

units.source_text: 虽然那样，单靠利钱生活恐怕也是维持不了。

en.t: Even so, they probably could not keep living on the interest alone.

units.source_text: 要是有谁能好好运用这笔钱生息，生活也就会过得很舒适了。

en.t: If someone could put that money to good use and make it earn interest, their life would become quite comfortable.

units.source_text: 可是，阿繁一时又想不起那种人来。

en.t: But Shige could not immediately think of anyone like that.
